text:
Anna (People Ops): Hey everyone :wave: Quick heads-up — orientation is scheduled for tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT / 6:00 PM BST. I just sent calendar invites to the new-hires group. Zoom link is in the invite.
Devon: Thanks Anna. Is that the one that includes the onboarding walkthrough and benefits overview?
Anna (People Ops): Yep — agenda in the invite: intros, platform tour, security quickstart, benefits. We'll record the session.
Jamal: I'm in APAC — will the recording be uploaded? I can't join live at 2am local. :sleeping:
Anna (People Ops): Recording will be uploaded to the #new-hires-notes Notion page and attached to the calendar event.
Olivia: Can you confirm the meeting link is a Zoom (not Meet)? My calendar tries to pick default Meet links and it confuses people.
Anna (People Ops): Zoom — we used the company Zoom account. The invite shows the correct link.
Luis: Quick timezone check for me — I'm IST. 10am PT should be 10:30pm IST, right?
Devon: 10:00 AM PT = 10:30 PM IST, yep.
Olivia: Could someone add a separate invite for the APAC-friendly repeat session? Not a lot of folks can make the live one.
Anna (People Ops): Good call. We're running a replay-friendly session next Wednesday at 8:00 AM PT / 8:30 PM IST. I'll create a second event and mark it "APAC-friendly".
Jamal: Sweet, thanks. Also can you cc onboarding buddy assignments in the calendar description? Makes it easier to find who to ping after.
Anna (People Ops): Will do. I'll add buddy names and the pre-read links in the description.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: "New Hire Orientation — Main" on 2025-01-14 10:00:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890. Recording: will be available after the meeting at https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/orientation-recordings. Event attached to calendar group: new-hires@redwood.com
Devon: One more — can the recording include captions? Some folks rely on that.
Anna (People Ops): We'll enable auto-captions in Zoom. If it's not available, we'll add a transcript and timestamped notes in Notion.
Olivia: Thanks! Also tagging @Devon to confirm you can see the second "APAC-friendly" invite when it's up.
Devon: I saw the main invite. Will watch for the APAC one and accept.
Jamal: Appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
Anna (People Ops): Cool — I'll post the APAC invite and the Notion page link in this thread once everything is live. If anyone doesn't get the invite, DM me.
Anna (People Ops): Notion page (pre-reads + links): https://notion.so/redwood/onboarding-pre-reads (will update with recording after session)
Luis: Got the main invite. Calendar event shows timezone conversions correctly for me. Thanks!
Anna (People Ops): Great — closing the loop here. Reminder email will go out 2 hours before the session with the link and checklist.
Devon: 👍
Jamal: Thanks Anna :)
Anna (People Ops): See you all tomorrow (or on the recording)!
